_doc: Hand-picked reference photos per product (and variant), relative to data/product-images/. Lists the ones known to produce accurate renders. A product or variant missing here falls back to the first images in data/product-images/<imageDir>/<variant>/. 'packaged' is the product as sold; 'unwrapped' is the bare product, used by in-use scenes (lather, shower). The bar soap's unwrapped photos are product-level: the bare puck looks the same for every scent.
